interface.longDescription:
A Managed Team that assesses opportunities, develops proposal responses, and reviews the work before submission so your team can respond to more RFPs, RFQs, grants, and other solicitations.

It analyzes solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria, assesses capability fit, gaps, risk, ROI, and pricing, researches the opportunity and competitive landscape, develops positioning and win themes, drafts the response, and reviews it for requirements coverage, compliance, consistency, and quality.

Configure the team with your company profile, pricing, past performance, case studies, brand guidelines, and review criteria. Receive structured research, proposal drafts, compliance reporting, review findings, recommendations, and next actions. Every stage stops for your approval before advancing.
defaultPrompt: Assess whether we should respond to this RFP
Analyze this solicitation and build a compliant response plan
Review this proposal against the requirements and evaluation criteria
